idea-plugin.name: MrScraper MCP
idea-plugin.description:
Connect the AI agents in your JetBrains IDE to MrScraper's hosted MCP server for web scraping, structured data extraction, and Google search.

Getting started

  1. Create an API key at app.mrscraper.com/api-tokens. The free plan includes 1,000 tokens a month.
  2. Click Connect… in the notification that appears, or choose Tools | Connect MrScraper MCP…, and paste the key.
  3. If the IDE asks whether to enable the mrscraper MCP server, accept it.

One connection covers every JetBrains AI agent that reads the shared MCP configuration (~/.ai/mcp/mcp.json), including AI Assistant, Junie, Codex, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.

What your AI agent can do

  • Fetch a web page's raw HTML, with optional browser rendering and geo-targeting
  • Extract fields from a page, or records from a paginated listing, as structured JSON
  • Map a website's URLs
  • Search Google and get parsed results
  • Rerun saved scrapers, read stored results, and check plan usage

Data and privacy

The plugin checks your API key with MrScraper, saves it in the IDE password storage, and adds it to the shared MCP configuration file so your AI agents can authenticate. The plugin collects no telemetry. When an AI agent uses MrScraper, the target URLs and tool inputs go to MrScraper. Manage the connection in Settings | Tools | MrScraper MCP; uninstalling the plugin removes the mrscraper entry.
